channel.title: Guinea - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Guinea, every source cited.

item.title: Guinea's Syli Junior wins UFOA-A U20 title
item.description: Aboubacar Keïta scored the only goal in the 40th minute to secure a 1-0 victory over Gambia.

item.title: Guinea minister suspends Siguiri governor and 21 officials
item.description: Minister Djenabou Touré suspended the interim governor, four prefects, and 17 sub-prefects on October 30, 2026.

item.title: Maïmouna Diakhaby appointed head of Port of Conakry
item.description: President Mamadi Doumbouya names strategy advisor to lead the autonomous port authority.

item.title: Kaloum FC held to draw by SOAR Académie
item.description: The team drew 0-0 for the sixth consecutive match, remaining third in Ligue 2.

item.title: Hilton opens first hotel in Guinea
item.description: The 196-room DoubleTree by Hilton Conakry Kaloum is set to open in 2029.
